prompt: elixir to_timeout Duration year month fields constraint
answer:
`to_timeout/1` supports durations only up to weeks. If the `:month` or `:year` fields are set, it raises an error.

Supported duration units include `:week`, `:day`, `:hour`, `:minute`, `:second`, and `:millisecond`.
